name: TOB Blessing Verse
description: A small, hand-curated bank of encouraging/blessing verse REFERENCES — does not store verse text for the app (the optional kjv_text field exists only to render social-media post images — founder decision 2026-09-24), matching this app's standing rule that Scripture text lives only in the Flutter client's own on-device SQLite Bible (see HANDOFF.md §5.7). The client resolves the actual verse text locally, in whatever language/version it already has installed, from bible_book/chapter/verse_start/verse_end. Used by two features: the Daily Verse screen (verse card, no AI involved) and the AI daily_devotional task (this reference is passed in as the anchor the AI writes its reflection around — the AI never invents which verse to use). System-Manager-only permissions, same as every other Bible Battle/content doctype in this app — read only through whitelisted API methods.

fields.label: KJV Text
fields.description: Exact KJV (public domain) text, used ONLY to render daily blessing post images for social media. The mobile app never reads this field — it resolves verse text on-device. Editing this text clears the approval below, so every change is re-checked.

fields.label: Checked & approved for social posts
fields.description: Tick only after checking the KJV text above against a printed or trusted KJV Bible. Approved verses may be posted automatically by the blessing automation without further review.

fields.label: Last Posted On
fields.description: Set by the blessing automation; the least recently posted approved verse is chosen next.
